bioAdditions: FamilySearch gives Mary Elizabeth Pringle a birth date of March 1898 (from the 1900 census), places her in Wilkes-Barre's 15th ward in 1920, and records her marriage in Luzerne Co. on 7 Jun 1922 to Thomas Christopher Halloran (1898-1967) (S1). No death date has been found.
